To Whom It May Concern,

STAY INDOORS NOW.

The virus is spreading rapidly, and we've already had multiple cases in our community. We urge everyone to stay home, wash your hands frequently, and practice social distancing.

Your cooperation will help us slow down the spread of COVID-19.

Sincerely,
[Your Business Name]
